content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a static site hosting service that allows users to host websites directly from their GitHub repositories. For digital creators, this means they can host their online stores without incurring additional costs or relying on third-party platforms. By leveraging GitHub Pages, creators can maintain full control over their stores and products, ensuring they can sell their digital goods without platform fees or restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind a GitHub Pages-hosted digital product store relies on a combination of free and paid tools. For instance, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can be used for backend logic, while Supabase or Google Sheets can serve as order storage solutions. Additionally, NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, enabling creators to accept cryptocurrency payments with a minimal 0.5% fee. This architecture ensures seamless payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership for creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. Creators of ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software can benefit from this infrastructure, as it provides a reliable and cost-effective way to sell their digital products online. By using GitHub Pages and other free tools, creators can reduce their reliance on third-party platforms and maintain full control over their stores and products.
GitHub Pages offers free hosting for digital product stores, reducing costs and increasing creator control.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this infrastructure work together include GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. These tools work in tandem to provide a seamless and efficient way to sell digital products online. For example, when a customer makes a purchase, the payment is verified by NOWPayments, and the product is delivered instantly via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a GitHub Pages-hosted digital product store today, creators can start by setting up a GitHub repository and creating a new branch for their store. They can then use a static site generator to build their store and configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Additionally, they can integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification and set up Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. With these components in place, creators can start selling their digital products online and benefiting from the flexibility and control that comes with this infrastructure.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use GitHub Pages to host their store and integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. This solution allows creators to accept cryptocurrency payments with a minimal 0.5% fee, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee. For instance, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921, making this solution a cost-effective alternative for digital creators.
